policy.FAIL: diagnose observed failure, apply at most one minimal relevant correction, refresh inventory, rerun same item once
policy.FAIL_AFTER_ONE_CORRECTION: append log and backlog, continue independent items; no second fix/retry
policy.BLOCKED: missing approved prerequisite, no PASS or synthetic product failure; continue independent items
policy.invalid_or_unavailable_fix: log reason and continue; do not guess APIs, widen scope or weaken acceptance
policy.safety_or_exhaustion: stop only on unknown/exhausted global allowance or unresolved process/credential/authority boundary; preserve results
policy.passing_earlier_source: retain historical PASS with source binding; never imply later edits are covered

repair_authority.allowed: minimum repository source/config/lock/acceptance defect directly causing named item failure; preserve product/spec semantics and pinned dependency choices
repair_authority.excluded: publishing/pushing/merging, shared service/credential changes, upstream key copying, toolchain/system installs, new dependency-version upgrades, bypassing tests/checks/policies or changing acceptance to manufacture PASS

source_refresh.meaning: named metadata inventory operation, no verification; source changes close previous source claim, renew exact item instruction under this signed bounded policy before only its same-command rerun
source_refresh.records: before/after source identity, patch, root cause, repair ordinal, exact repeated command, actual output; no product gate opening from this exception

metadata_effects: Create exclusive evidence/output roots0700, no prior attempt overwritten; separate item/attempt directories and append-only ledger.
Run every named item serially; no two writers per Cargo target; no extra standalone preflight/version/probe/check commands.
Load only named P0 toolchain fields and nonsecret local Docker endpoint; no fixture env/API keys/provider calls. Preserve all old targets/scopes.

Capture bounded stdout/stderr and exit per attempt, artifact metadata/SHA for produced binary/library/image-build result without new Docker inspect/run. Copy completed local build artifacts before later overwrite, record missing artifacts honestly.

Source-only targeted implementation fixes are authorized in named item slots after actual failure; no speculative fix. Fresh source inventory and recorded same-item instruction precede one rerun; no repeated permission request per defect within this signed scope.

Source reviews are isolated artifacts only; no reviewer may execute tests/builds/probes. Required specialized code review for any correction is source-only and confined to correction artifacts; no hidden verification commands.

Every failed/unavailable/blocked item gets log row and backlog entry. Final table reports PASS, PASS_AFTER_ONE_CORRECTION, FAIL, FAIL_AFTER_ONE_CORRECTION,BLOCKED,NOT_RUN and source identity. No acceptance/archive/reflection while failures/blockers remain.
